'''Astral Grass Walls''' are background [[wall]]s that replace [[Grass Wall]]s in the [[Astral Infection]] [[biome]] upon its creation.
== Notes ==
*Unlike other natural walls generated by the Astral Infection, natural Astral Grass Walls can be collected. 
*Player placed Astral Grass Walls will ''not'' count as valid housing.
